method: Three native arXiv API metadata queries plus twenty arxiv.org-restricted indexed web queries; inspect abstracts and selected HTML introductions/formalization descriptions. Not an exhaustive arXiv full-text or linked-code audit.

limits: Metadata queries can miss lemmas not advertised in metadata; indexed full-text discovery is incomplete. No absence claim about all arXiv papers or all linked code.
